verdict.rationale: Intercom documents a Fin Agent API for calling Fin programmatically from your own systems (docs-3). The Fin API platform exposes answer-generation and knowledge-retrieval APIs (docs-39), and an official TypeScript SDK wraps the Intercom APIs, including AI content endpoints with paginated iterators (gh-1, gh-2, gh-3). Webhooks add event-driven integration (docs-6). Missing for 10: the orchestration endpoints (discover capabilities, ask Fin, run a procedure, escalate) are available only in the Preview API version (docs-4), no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed fin.ai paths (probe-3), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Fin via the API.
